text:
Sustainability: {top_fix_name} is a durable capital improvement that will keep reducing heat loss from the greenhouse for many years. By saving about {top_fix_saves_usd} dollars a year in heating costs, it supports the long-term profitability of {name}. By burning about {gallons_saved} fewer gallons of fuel each year, the farm will emit about {carbon_tons_saved} fewer metric tons of carbon dioxide annually, a lasting contribution to environmental stewardship.

Metrics to track impacts: We will record heating fuel deliveries and heating bills every season and compare them with our estimated pre-project heating cost of {estimate_point} dollars a year, adjusting for winter severity with heating degree days for {town}. We will also log greenhouse temperatures and crop output, so we can show that energy use has fallen while production efficiency has been maintained.

Post-project sustainability: The measure pays back its full cost in about {top_fix_payback_years} years, so its savings keep benefiting the farm well beyond the grant period.

Warranties and guarantees: {UNKNOWN: product warranty and installer service guarantee terms}.

Operation and maintenance: Farm staff will inspect {top_fix_name} before each heating season, repair any damage promptly and operate it as designed, so the system remains functional and effective in the long term.
